# GiriBioAI

> An interactive lab to learn how AI and large language models work, from tokens, embeddings and attention to sampling, training, RAG, agents, evals and Bio-AI. Everything is simulated in the browser.

GiriBioAI is a free educational web app for beginners who want to understand the moving parts of modern LLMs, and how the same ideas apply to DNA, proteins and molecules, without a GPU or API keys. Developed by Girinath G Pillai with AI assistance.

## Foundations
- [Neural Network Basics](/neural-networks): A single-neuron playground and a tiny network trained live with gradient descent.
- [Tokens](/tokens): How text becomes integers via BPE-style tokenization.
- [Vocabulary](/vocabulary): How a model's vocabulary is built and why size matters.
- [Pre-training](/pretraining): Next-token prediction, with a tiny in-browser bigram trainer.
- [Fine-tuning](/finetuning): Loss-curve simulator for full, LoRA, and RLHF training.

## Inside the model
- [Embeddings & Attention](/embeddings): A 2D embedding map, vector arithmetic and a toy self-attention heatmap.
- [Transformer Walkthrough](/transformer): Step through one GPT block number by number, from embeddings to next-token logits.
- [Sampling & Decoding](/sampling): Temperature, top-k, top-p, repetition penalty, greedy and beam search.
- [Context, KV Cache & MoE](/context): Context windows, KV cache memory and Mixture-of-Experts routing.

## Building with LLMs
- [Prompt Builder](/prompt-builder): Compose role, context, task, format and constraints.
- [Prompt Training](/prompt-training): Seven prompting habits with a quiz.
- [RAG](/rag): Retrieval-Augmented Generation with a live TF-IDF retriever. Lab settings can be shared as links.
- [Orchestration](/orchestration): Compose routers, tools, and agents into a flow.
- [Agent Loop Tracer](/agent-loop): Step through a tool-calling agent with MCP JSON-RPC messages and exact token counts.
- [Evals, Safety & Quantization](/evals): Hallucination checks, LLM-as-judge, prompt injection defenses, quantization.

## Bio-AI
- [Bio-AI with LLMs](/bio-ai): DNA k-mers and codons, protein residues, SMILES tokens and a toy protein language model.

## Labs
- [Chat Simulator](/chat-sim): Tokens, cost and latency per chat message.
- [Local LLM Setup](/local-llm-sim): GPU, OS, model, runtime and MCP setup walkthrough.
- [Agentic AI, RAG & MCP slides](/agents-slides): A 50-slide deck.

## Optional
- [Home](/): Overview and curriculum.
- [Learning path](/path): Tracks and progress.
- [Glossary](/glossary): All key terms.
- [About](/about): Mission and credits.
